headline: Brazil online betting ban boosts retail and supermarket sales: BTG Pactual
summary: The prohibition of online betting platforms in Brazil is beginning to boost sales in supermarkets and retail stores. Data from the Brazilian Supermarket Association was cited in a BTG Pactual report.
why: Disposable income previously allocated to online gambling is redirected toward consumer staples and discretionary retail, shifting domestic consumption patterns monitored by institutional investors.

impacts.name: Brazilian Retail and Supermarkets
impacts.why: Prohibition of betting platforms redirects consumer wallet share toward physical retail and grocery spending.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Regulatory restrictions on online gambling divert consumer disposable funds back into traditional retail and supermarket channels, increasing recorded sales volumes.
